taskDescription: Goal: write minimal-G detailed design (solver-role tools) under design v1 section 2 G, plus no-model verification plan for design section 9 items V-1..V-5. Core intent: unblock solver roles (Recon, Domain Solver, Engineer, Verifier) — currently have zero tools after E intake; need per-challenge binding, workspace rw, HTTP, scripts, before first real-model solve smoke. Design is unverified draft; nothing executed.
currentStatus: DONE: G design draft written and cross-linked; V-1..V-5 plan written, labels aligned to design. REMAINING: nothing executed. V-1..V-5 need user go-ahead. V-6 (ARM64 product image OS isolation) and V-7 (real-model smoke, needs separate authorization) not planned. Design section 9 V-results not yet written back. Plan says delete after results reflected into design.
keyDecisions: Decision: solver-to-challenge binding = candidate A — Coordinator calls challenge.assign(challenge, role) before task; host attaches challengeId to pending dispatch keyed by parent+role; solver tools take no challenge id — Reason: only minimal extension of C pending-dispatch rule; tool args cannot redirect challenge; candidate B (parse prompt text) unreliable

Decision: workspace roots materials (ro), work (per-session rw), published (host-written, D), jobs (host-owned, read via job.read); virtual roots hide host paths — Reason: materials immutable, session isolation, no host paths to model
Decision: no archive-unpack tool; unpack inside job in work/ — Reason: avoids new tool; deferred until real need shown

Decision: HTTP origin must equal target origin exactly; redirects off by default, each hop re-checked; connection pinned to resolved address; per-challenge cookie jar; self-signed TLS accepted only for scoped origin (proposal) — Reason: scope enforcement at tool layer, DNS-rebinding defense, CTF targets often self-signed

Decision: managed job.run (argv only, env whitelist, /dev/null stdin, process-group kill) instead of native bash — Reason: OpenCode native shell inherits provider and RPC credentials from its process env
Decision: job network explicitly not scope-enforced; recorded as known gap section 5.5 — Reason: network isolation design is pending in design v1 section 3; not claiming enforcement
Decision: product-level job isolation needs separate OS user plus per-challenge group, verified on ARM64 image in V-6 — Reason: same-user scripts could read materials or OpenCode environ
Decision: Intake gets no workspace write (narrows design H table row) — Reason: E design Intake needs read only; amend H only if D or tests show need
Decision: remove legacy plugin manifest names workspace.patch, workspace.unpack, observation.read, hypothesis.* ; candidate.register left to D — Reason: belong to retired single-solver design
userContribution: Specified the scope for minimal G: solver-role workspace read/write and HTTP/script execution, plus binding of solver sessions to a challenge.
